description: CUAD clause category -> Orpheus clause_type. Seeded, not complete. Categories absent from this file are reported as unmapped by orph_benchmark_extraction() rather than being scored as misses, so extending it is the intended way to widen the benchmark. Category names must match those in the CUAD file exactly; the loader reads the vocabulary from the data rather than assuming it.
